objects.description: Opaque handle to a GEOS reentrant API context. Must be created with GEOS_init_r() and freed with GEOS_finish_r(). Thread-confined: do not share a handle across threads concurrently.

Opaque geometry object representing any GEOS geometry (Point, LineString, Polygon, Multi*, GeometryCollection, curve types). Create via GEOSGeom_create* and related functions; destroy with GEOSGeom_destroy(). Many API functions consume/produce this type.
Opaque prepared-geometry wrapper around a GEOSGeometry to accelerate predicates and distance. Create with GEOSPrepare[_r]() and destroy with GEOSPreparedGeom_destroy[_r]().
Opaque fixed-size sequence of coordinates used to build Points/LineStrings/LinearRings. Create via GEOSCoordSeq_create* and destroy with GEOSCoordSeq_destroy().
Opaque STRtree spatial index. Create with GEOSSTRtree_create[_r]() and destroy with GEOSSTRtree_destroy[_r](). Does not take ownership of inserted items.

Opaque parameter object controlling buffer generation (end caps, joins, mitre limit, quadrant segments, single-sided). Create with GEOSBufferParams_create[_r]() and destroy with GEOSBufferParams_destroy[_r]().
Opaque parameter object for coverage cleaning options (snapping distance, gap max width, overlap merge strategy).
Opaque parameter object for GEOS make-valid operation, controlling method and keep-collapsed behavior.
Opaque clustering result object describing clusters of input geometries and memberships. Destroy with GEOSClusterInfo_destroy[_r]().
Opaque reader for parsing WKT into GEOSGeometry. Create/destroy with GEOSWKTReader_create[_r]/GEOSWKTReader_destroy[_r].
Opaque writer for serializing GEOSGeometry to WKT. Create/destroy with GEOSWKTWriter_create[_r]/GEOSWKTWriter_destroy[_r].
Opaque reader for parsing WKB/HEXWKB into GEOSGeometry. Create/destroy with GEOSWKBReader_create[_r]/GEOSWKBReader_destroy[_r].
Opaque writer for serializing GEOSGeometry to WKB/HEXWKB. Create/destroy with GEOSWKBWriter_create[_r]/GEOSWKBWriter_destroy[_r].
Opaque reader for parsing GeoJSON into GEOSGeometry.
Opaque writer for serializing GEOSGeometry to GeoJSON.

objects.definition:
enum GEOSGeomTypes {
    GEOS_POINT,
    GEOS_LINESTRING,
    GEOS_LINEARRING,
    GEOS_POLYGON,
    GEOS_MULTIPOINT,
    GEOS_MULTILINESTRING,
    GEOS_MULTIPOLYGON,
    GEOS_GEOMETRYCOLLECTION,
    GEOS_CIRCULARSTRING,
    GEOS_COMPOUNDCURVE,
    GEOS_CURVEPOLYGON,
    GEOS_MULTICURVE,
    GEOS_MULTISURFACE,
};
objects.description: Enumeration of geometry type IDs returned by GEOSGeomTypeId and used when constructing collections.
Enumeration for WKB byte order (big-endian XDR or little-endian NDR).
Enumeration for WKB flavor selection (extended vs ISO).
Enumeration of strategies used to merge overlaps during coverage cleaning.
Enumeration controlling boundary node rule used in relate operations.
Flags modifying validity checking behavior.
Method choices for repairing invalid geometries.
Behavior flags for GEOSGeom_setPrecision.
End-cap styles for buffering linework.
Join styles for buffering linework.
Parameter modes for polygon hull simplify operations.
Behavior flags for Voronoi diagram generation.

functions.name: GEOS_interruptRegisterCallback
functions.signature: GEOSInterruptCallback *GEOS_interruptRegisterCallback(GEOSInterruptCallback* cb)
functions.description: Registers a global interruption callback invoked at possible interruption points. Returns the previously registered callback or NULL. Use to implement cooperative cancellation across threads.
requirements: cb may be NULL to clear the existing callback
Callback must be async-safe with respect to GEOS internal state (it may be called at many locations)
Use GEOS_interruptCancel() to clear pending requests if needed

functions.name: GEOSContext_setInterruptCallback_r
functions.signature: GEOSContextInterruptCallback *GEOSContext_setInterruptCallback_r(GEOSContextHandle_t extHandle, GEOSContextInterruptCallback* cb, void* userData)
functions.description: Registers a per-context interruption callback which may request interruption by returning non-zero. Returns the previous callback or NULL.
requirements: extHandle must be a valid context from GEOS_init_r() and used by one thread at a time
cb may be NULL to clear the callback
Callback should be lightweight and must not call back into the same context in ways that deadlock

functions.name: GEOS_interruptRequest
functions.signature: void GEOS_interruptRequest(void)
functions.description: Requests a safe interruption of the next thread that checks for interrupts. Use for global cooperative cancellation.
requirements: Call at any time to signal an interrupt; the next interruption check may abort the running operation
To interrupt a specific thread reliably, call GEOS_interruptThread() from code executing on that thread

functions.name: GEOS_interruptThread
functions.signature: void GEOS_interruptThread(void)
functions.description: Requests interruption of the current calling thread (thread-local).
requirements: Must be called from the thread you intend to interrupt

functions.name: GEOS_interruptCancel
functions.signature: void GEOS_interruptCancel(void)
functions.description: Cancels any pending global interruption request.
requirements: Call to clear previous GEOS_interruptRequest() if no longer desired

functions.name: GEOS_init_r
functions.signature: GEOSContextHandle_t GEOS_init_r(void)
functions.description: Allocates and initializes a re-entrant GEOS context for use with all *_r functions. Contexts must be used by a single thread at a time.
requirements: Caller must later free with GEOS_finish_r()
Use the returned context as first parameter to all *_r functions for thread safety
Each context must be used by only one thread at a time

functions.name: GEOS_finish_r
functions.signature: void GEOS_finish_r(GEOSContextHandle_t handle)
functions.description: Frees a GEOS re-entrant context and its resources.
requirements: handle must have been returned by GEOS_init_r()
Do not use the handle after calling this function
Ensure all objects allocated with this context are properly destroyed as required by their APIs

functions.name: GEOSContext_setNoticeHandler_r
functions.signature: GEOSMessageHandler GEOSContext_setNoticeHandler_r(GEOSContextHandle_t extHandle, GEOSMessageHandler nf)
functions.description: Sets a printf-style notice handler for the context; returns previous handler or NULL.
requirements: extHandle must be a valid context
nf may be NULL to clear the handler
Handler must follow GEOSMessageHandler varargs semantics and be thread-safe for this context

functions.name: GEOSContext_setErrorHandler_r
functions.signature: GEOSMessageHandler GEOSContext_setErrorHandler_r(GEOSContextHandle_t extHandle, GEOSMessageHandler ef)
functions.description: Sets a printf-style error handler for the context; returns previous handler or NULL.
requirements: extHandle must be a valid context
ef may be NULL to clear the handler
Handler must follow GEOSMessageHandler varargs semantics and be thread-safe for this context

functions.name: GEOSContext_setNoticeMessageHandler_r
functions.signature: GEOSMessageHandler_r GEOSContext_setNoticeMessageHandler_r(GEOSContextHandle_t extHandle, GEOSMessageHandler_r nf, void *userData)
functions.description: Sets a notice message handler (message, userdata) for the context; returns previous handler or NULL.
requirements: extHandle must be valid
nf may be NULL to clear the handler
userData is stored and passed to the callback; must remain valid while the handler is active

functions.name: GEOSContext_setErrorMessageHandler_r
functions.signature: GEOSMessageHandler_r GEOSContext_setErrorMessageHandler_r(GEOSContextHandle_t extHandle, GEOSMessageHandler_r ef, void *userData)
functions.description: Sets an error message handler (message, userdata) for the context; returns previous handler or NULL.
requirements: extHandle must be valid
ef may be NULL to clear the handler
userData must remain valid while the handler is active

functions.name: GEOSCoordSeq_create_r
functions.signature: GEOSCoordSequence *GEOSCoordSeq_create_r(GEOSContextHandle_t handle, unsigned int size, unsigned int dims)
functions.description: Creates a coordinate sequence with the given size and dimensionality (2, 3, or 4).
requirements: handle must be a valid context
dims must be 2, 3, or 4
size is the number of coordinates; large sizes allocate proportionally
Result must be destroyed with GEOSCoordSeq_destroy_r() or transferred to a geometry that assumes ownership as documented by constructors

functions.name: GEOSCoordSeq_createWithDimensions_r
functions.signature: GEOSCoordSequence *GEOSCoordSeq_createWithDimensions_r(GEOSContextHandle_t handle, unsigned int size, int hasZ, int hasM)
functions.description: Creates a coordinate sequence specifying presence of Z and M dimensions.
requirements: handle must be valid
size is number of coordinates
hasZ and hasM are booleans (0/1) determining dimension (XY, XYZ, XYM, XYZM)
Destroy with GEOSCoordSeq_destroy_r() unless ownership is transferred

functions.name: GEOSCoordSeq_copyFromBuffer_r
functions.signature: GEOSCoordSequence *GEOSCoordSeq_copyFromBuffer_r(GEOSContextHandle_t handle, const double* buf, unsigned int size, int hasZ, int hasM)
functions.description: Creates a coordinate sequence by copying from an interleaved buffer (e.g., XYXY… or XYZM…).
requirements: handle must be valid
buf must point to at least size*(2 + hasZ + hasM) doubles
hasZ/hasM indicate layout of buf
Caller retains ownership of buf

functions.name: GEOSCoordSeq_copyFromArrays_r
functions.signature: GEOSCoordSequence *GEOSCoordSeq_copyFromArrays_r(GEOSContextHandle_t handle, const double* x, const double* y, const double* z, const double* m, unsigned int size)
functions.description: Creates a coordinate sequence by copying from separate X/Y/Z/M arrays.
requirements: handle must be valid
x and y must be non-NULL and have at least size elements
z and m may be NULL if not present
All arrays must be at least length size

functions.name: GEOSCoordSeq_copyToBuffer_r
functions.signature: int GEOSCoordSeq_copyToBuffer_r(GEOSContextHandle_t handle, const GEOSCoordSequence* s, double* buf, int hasZ, int hasM)
functions.description: Copies a coordinate sequence into an interleaved buffer (XY[Z][M]). Returns 1 on success, 0 on error.
requirements: handle must be valid
s must be a valid sequence
buf must have capacity of size*(2 + hasZ + hasM) doubles
hasZ/hasM control which dimensions are written

functions.name: GEOSCoordSeq_copyToArrays_r
functions.signature: int GEOSCoordSeq_copyToArrays_r(GEOSContextHandle_t handle, const GEOSCoordSequence* s, double* x, double* y, double* z, double* m)
functions.description: Copies a coordinate sequence into separate X/Y/Z/M arrays. Returns 1 on success, 0 on error.
requirements: handle must be valid
s must be a valid sequence
x and y must be non-NULL and large enough for the sequence size
z and m may be NULL; if non-NULL must have adequate length

functions.name: GEOSCoordSeq_clone_r
functions.signature: GEOSCoordSequence *GEOSCoordSeq_clone_r(GEOSContextHandle_t handle, const GEOSCoordSequence* s)
functions.description: Clones a coordinate sequence and returns a new owned copy.
requirements: handle must be valid
s must be a valid sequence
Destroy the result with GEOSCoordSeq_destroy_r() unless transferred

functions.name: GEOSCoordSeq_destroy_r
functions.signature: void GEOSCoordSeq_destroy_r(GEOSContextHandle_t handle, GEOSCoordSequence* s)
functions.description: Destroys a coordinate sequence and frees memory.
requirements: handle must be valid
s may be NULL (no effect)
Do not destroy sequences owned by a geometry

functions.name: GEOSCoordSeq_hasZ_r
functions.signature: char GEOSCoordSeq_hasZ_r(GEOSContextHandle_t handle, GEOSCoordSequence* s)
functions.description: Returns 1 if the sequence stores Z ordinates, 0 if not, 2 on exception.
requirements: handle must be valid
s must be a valid sequence

functions.name: GEOSCoordSeq_hasM_r
functions.signature: char GEOSCoordSeq_hasM_r(GEOSContextHandle_t handle, GEOSCoordSequence* s)
functions.description: Returns 1 if the sequence stores M ordinates, 0 if not, 2 on exception.
requirements: handle must be valid
s must be a valid sequence

functions.name: GEOSCoordSeq_setX_r
functions.signature: int GEOSCoordSeq_setX_r(GEOSContextHandle_t handle, GEOSCoordSequence* s, unsigned int idx, double val)
functions.description: Sets the X ordinate at index idx. Returns non-zero on success, 0 on exception.
requirements: handle must be valid
s must be a valid, mutable sequence
idx is zero-based and must be < sequence size

functions.name: GEOSCoordSeq_setY_r
functions.signature: int GEOSCoordSeq_setY_r(GEOSContextHandle_t handle, GEOSCoordSequence* s, unsigned int idx, double val)
functions.description: Sets the Y ordinate at index idx. Returns non-zero on success, 0 on exception.
requirements: handle must be valid
s must be a valid, mutable sequence
idx must be within range [0, size)

functions.name: GEOSCoordSeq_setZ_r
functions.signature: int GEOSCoordSeq_setZ_r(GEOSContextHandle_t handle, GEOSCoordSequence* s, unsigned int idx, double val)
functions.description: Sets the Z ordinate at index idx (sequence must have Z). Returns non-zero on success, 0 on exception.
requirements: handle must be valid
s must be a valid, mutable sequence with Z dimension
idx must be within range

functions.name: GEOSCoordSeq_setM_r
functions.signature: int GEOSCoordSeq_setM_r(GEOSContextHandle_t handle, GEOSCoordSequence* s, unsigned int idx, double val)
functions.description: Sets the M ordinate at index idx (sequence must have M). Returns non-zero on success, 0 on exception.
requirements: handle must be valid
s must be a valid, mutable sequence with M dimension
idx must be within range

functions.name: GEOSCoordSeq_setXY_r
functions.signature: int GEOSCoordSeq_setXY_r(GEOSContextHandle_t handle, GEOSCoordSequence* s, unsigned int idx, double x, double y)
functions.description: Sets both X and Y ordinates at index idx. Returns non-zero on success, 0 on exception.
requirements: handle must be valid
s must be a valid, mutable sequence
idx must be within range

functions.name: GEOSCoordSeq_setXYZ_r
functions.signature: int GEOSCoordSeq_setXYZ_r(GEOSContextHandle_t handle, GEOSCoordSequence* s, unsigned int idx, double x, double y, double z)
functions.description: Sets X, Y, Z ordinates at index idx. Returns non-zero on success, 0 on exception.
requirements: handle must be valid
s must be a valid, mutable sequence with Z
idx must be within range

functions.name: GEOSCoordSeq_setOrdinate_r
functions.signature: int GEOSCoordSeq_setOrdinate_r(GEOSContextHandle_t handle, GEOSCoordSequence* s, unsigned int idx, unsigned int dim, double val)
functions.description: Sets the dim-th ordinate at index idx. Returns non-zero on success, 0 on exception.
requirements: handle must be valid
s must be a valid, mutable sequence
idx must be within range
dim is zero-based within the sequence dimensionality

functions.name: GEOSCoordSeq_getX_r
functions.signature: int GEOSCoordSeq_getX_r(GEOSContextHandle_t handle, const GEOSCoordSequence* s, unsigned int idx, double *val)
functions.description: Reads the X ordinate at index idx into val. Returns non-zero on success, 0 on exception.
requirements: handle must be valid
s must be a valid sequence
val must be non-NULL
idx must be within range

functions.name: GEOSCoordSeq_getY_r
functions.signature: int GEOSCoordSeq_getY_r(GEOSContextHandle_t handle, const GEOSCoordSequence* s, unsigned int idx, double *val)
functions.description: Reads the Y ordinate at index idx into val. Returns non-zero on success, 0 on exception.
requirements: handle must be valid
s must be a valid sequence
val must be non-NULL
idx must be within range

functions.name: GEOSCoordSeq_getZ_r
functions.signature: int GEOSCoordSeq_getZ_r(GEOSContextHandle_t handle, const GEOSCoordSequence* s, unsigned int idx, double *val)
functions.description: Reads the Z ordinate at index idx into val. Returns non-zero on success, 0 on exception.
requirements: handle must be valid
s must have Z dimension
val must be non-NULL
idx must be within range

functions.name: GEOSCoordSeq_getM_r
functions.signature: int GEOSCoordSeq_getM_r(GEOSContextHandle_t handle, const GEOSCoordSequence* s, unsigned int idx, double *val)
functions.description: Reads the M ordinate at index idx into val. Returns non-zero on success, 0 on exception.
requirements: handle must be valid
s must have M dimension
val must be non-NULL
idx must be within range

functions.name: GEOSCoordSeq_getXY_r
functions.signature: int GEOSCoordSeq_getXY_r(GEOSContextHandle_t handle, const GEOSCoordSequence* s, unsigned int idx, double *x, double *y)
functions.description: Reads X and Y ordinates at index idx. Returns non-zero on success, 0 on exception.
requirements: handle must be valid
s must be a valid sequence
x and y must be non-NULL
idx must be within range

functions.name: GEOSCoordSeq_getXYZ_r
functions.signature: int GEOSCoordSeq_getXYZ_r(GEOSContextHandle_t handle, const GEOSCoordSequence* s, unsigned int idx, double *x, double *y, double *z)
functions.description: Reads X, Y, Z ordinates at index idx. Returns non-zero on success, 0 on exception.
requirements: handle must be valid
s must have Z dimension
x, y, z must be non-NULL
idx must be within range

functions.name: GEOSCoordSeq_getOrdinate_r
functions.signature: int GEOSCoordSeq_getOrdinate_r(GEOSContextHandle_t handle, const GEOSCoordSequence* s, unsigned int idx, unsigned int dim, double *val)
functions.description: Reads the dim-th ordinate at index idx. Returns non-zero on success, 0 on exception.
requirements: handle must be valid
s must be a valid sequence
val must be non-NULL
idx must be within range
dim must be within the sequence dimensionality

functions.name: GEOSCoordSeq_getSize_r
functions.signature: int GEOSCoordSeq_getSize_r(GEOSContextHandle_t handle, const GEOSCoordSequence* s, unsigned int *size)
functions.description: Retrieves the sequence size (number of coordinates). Returns non-zero on success, 0 on exception.
requirements: handle must be valid
s must be a valid sequence
size must be non-NULL

functions.name: GEOSCoordSeq_getDimensions_r
functions.signature: int GEOSCoordSeq_getDimensions_r(GEOSContextHandle_t handle, const GEOSCoordSequence* s, unsigned int *dims)
functions.description: Retrieves the sequence dimensionality (2–4). Returns non-zero on success, 0 on exception.
requirements: handle must be valid
s must be a valid sequence
dims must be non-NULL

functions.name: GEOSCoordSeq_isCCW_r
functions.signature: int GEOSCoordSeq_isCCW_r(GEOSContextHandle_t handle, const GEOSCoordSequence* s, char* is_ccw)
functions.description: Determines if a closed sequence is counter-clockwise. Returns 1 on success, 0 on exception; sets is_ccw=1 if CCW, 0 otherwise.
requirements: handle must be valid
s must represent a closed linear ring; invalid/short sequences yield false per docs
is_ccw must be non-NULL

functions.name: GEOSProject_r
functions.signature: double GEOSProject_r(GEOSContextHandle_t handle, const GEOSGeometry *line, const GEOSGeometry *point)
functions.description: Projects a point onto a LineString and returns the distance along the line from its start to the projection. Returns -1 on exception.
requirements: handle must be valid
line must be a LineString
point must be a Point

functions.name: GEOSInterpolate_r
functions.signature: GEOSGeometry *GEOSInterpolate_r(GEOSContextHandle_t handle, const GEOSGeometry *line, double d)
functions.description: Interpolates a point at distance d from the start of a LineString. Returns a new Point geometry.
requirements: handle must be valid
line must be a LineString
Caller must free returned geometry with GEOSGeom_destroy_r()

functions.name: GEOSProjectNormalized_r
functions.signature: double GEOSProjectNormalized_r(GEOSContextHandle_t handle, const GEOSGeometry *g, const GEOSGeometry *p)
functions.description: Projects a point to a normalized distance fraction along a LineString (0..1). Returns -1 on exception.
requirements: handle must be valid
g must be a LineString
p must be a Point

functions.name: GEOSInterpolateNormalized_r
functions.signature: GEOSGeometry *GEOSInterpolateNormalized_r(GEOSContextHandle_t handle, const GEOSGeometry *g, double d)
functions.description: Interpolates a point at the given normalized fraction (0..1) along a LineString. Returns a new Point.
requirements: handle must be valid
g must be a LineString
Caller must free returned geometry with GEOSGeom_destroy_r()

functions.name: GEOSBuffer_r
functions.signature: extern GEOSGeometry GEOS_DLL *GEOSBuffer_r(GEOSContextHandle_t handle, const GEOSGeometry* g, double width, int quadsegs);
functions.description: Creates a buffer around the input geometry using the given distance and number of quadrant segments. Returns a newly allocated geometry to be freed with GEOSGeom_destroy_r. Use the reentrant API via a valid GEOS context.
requirements: handle must be a valid GEOSContextHandle_t obtained from GEOS_init_r
g must be a valid, initialized GEOSGeometry pointer
quadsegs should be a positive integer (more segments produce smoother curves)
Returned geometry must be freed with GEOSGeom_destroy_r(handle, ...)
On error, NULL is returned; caller must check for NULL before use

functions.name: GEOSBufferParams_create_r
functions.signature: extern GEOSBufferParams GEOS_DLL *GEOSBufferParams_create_r(GEOSContextHandle_t handle);
functions.description: Allocates a new GEOSBufferParams object with default buffering parameters for use with GEOSBufferWithParams_r.
requirements: handle must be a valid GEOSContextHandle_t from GEOS_init_r
Returned GEOSBufferParams* must be destroyed with GEOSBufferParams_destroy_r(handle, ...) to avoid leaks
Returns NULL on exception; caller must check for NULL

functions.name: GEOSBufferParams_destroy_r
functions.signature: extern void GEOS_DLL GEOSBufferParams_destroy_r(GEOSContextHandle_t handle, GEOSBufferParams* parms);
functions.description: Destroys a GEOSBufferParams instance previously created, freeing all associated memory.
requirements: handle must be a valid GEOSContextHandle_t
parms must be a GEOSBufferParams* previously returned by GEOSBufferParams_create_r (or compatible) and not already destroyed
Safe to pass NULL? unknown (not documented); caller should avoid passing NULL

functions.name: GEOSBufferParams_setEndCapStyle_r
functions.signature: extern int GEOS_DLL GEOSBufferParams_setEndCapStyle_r(GEOSContextHandle_t handle, GEOSBufferParams* p, int style);
functions.description: Sets the end-cap style (see GEOSBufCapStyles) on a GEOSBufferParams object for line buffers.
requirements: handle must be valid
p must be a valid, initialized GEOSBufferParams*
style must be one of GEOSBUF_CAP_ROUND, GEOSBUF_CAP_FLAT, GEOSBUF_CAP_SQUARE
Returns 1 on success, 0 on exception; caller must check return value

functions.name: GEOSBufferParams_setJoinStyle_r
functions.signature: extern int GEOS_DLL GEOSBufferParams_setJoinStyle_r(GEOSContextHandle_t handle, GEOSBufferParams* p, int joinStyle);
functions.description: Sets the join style (see GEOSBufJoinStyles) for corners in a buffered line on a GEOSBufferParams object.
requirements: handle must be valid
p must be a valid GEOSBufferParams*
joinStyle must be one of GEOSBUF_JOIN_ROUND, GEOSBUF_JOIN_MITRE, GEOSBUF_JOIN_BEVEL
Returns 1 on success, 0 on exception

functions.name: GEOSBufferParams_setMitreLimit_r
functions.signature: extern int GEOS_DLL GEOSBufferParams_setMitreLimit_r(GEOSContextHandle_t handle, GEOSBufferParams* p, double mitreLimit);
functions.description: Sets the mitre (miter) limit used when join style is mitre to cap excessively long spikes at sharp corners.
requirements: handle must be valid
p must be a valid GEOSBufferParams*
mitreLimit should be positive; extremely small or negative values are not meaningful and may fail
Returns 1 on success, 0 on exception

functions.name: GEOSBufferParams_setQuadrantSegments_r
functions.signature: extern int GEOS_DLL GEOSBufferParams_setQuadrantSegments_r(GEOSContextHandle_t handle, GEOSBufferParams* p, int quadSegs);
functions.description: Sets the number of line segments per quadrant to approximate circular arcs in buffering.
requirements: handle must be valid
p must be a valid GEOSBufferParams*
quadSegs should be a positive integer; larger values increase output detail and size
Returns 1 on success, 0 on exception

functions.name: GEOSBufferParams_setSingleSided_r
functions.signature: extern int GEOS_DLL GEOSBufferParams_setSingleSided_r(GEOSContextHandle_t handle, GEOSBufferParams* p, int singleSided);
functions.description: Enables or disables single-sided buffering on a GEOSBufferParams object for line inputs.
requirements: handle must be valid
p must be a valid GEOSBufferParams*
singleSided should be 0 or 1
Returns 1 on success, 0 on exception

functions.name: GEOSBufferWithParams_r
functions.signature: extern GEOSGeometry GEOS_DLL *GEOSBufferWithParams_r(GEOSContextHandle_t handle, const GEOSGeometry* g, const GEOSBufferParams* p, double width);
functions.description: Generates a buffer around a geometry using the provided GEOSBufferParams settings and buffer distance.
requirements: handle must be valid
g must be a valid GEOSGeometry*
p must be a valid GEOSBufferParams* created by GEOSBufferParams_create_r and configured as desired
Returns newly allocated geometry or NULL on error; free with GEOSGeom_destroy_r
width may be positive (expand) or negative (contract); extreme negative values may collapse to empty

functions.name: GEOSBufferWithStyle_r
functions.signature: extern GEOSGeometry GEOS_DLL *GEOSBufferWithStyle_r(GEOSContextHandle_t handle, const GEOSGeometry* g, double width, int quadsegs, int endCapStyle, int joinStyle, double mitreLimit);
functions.description: Buffers a geometry with explicit style parameters (quadsegs, end-cap, join style, mitre limit) without using a GEOSBufferParams object.
requirements: handle must be valid
g must be a valid GEOSGeometry*
quadsegs should be a positive integer
endCapStyle must be a value from GEOSBufCapStyles
joinStyle must be a value from GEOSBufJoinStyles
mitreLimit should be positive for mitre joins
Returns new geometry or NULL on error; caller frees with GEOSGeom_destroy_r

functions.name: GEOSDensify_r
functions.signature: extern GEOSGeometry GEOS_DLL *GEOSDensify_r(GEOSContextHandle_t handle, const GEOSGeometry* g, double tolerance);
functions.description: Adds vertices to linear components so that no segment exceeds the given tolerance, returning a new geometry.
requirements: handle must be valid
g must be a valid geometry; non-linear components are unchanged
tolerance should be > 0 to have effect
Returns new geometry or NULL on exception; free with GEOSGeom_destroy_r

functions.name: GEOSOffsetCurve_r
functions.signature: extern GEOSGeometry GEOS_DLL *GEOSOffsetCurve_r(GEOSContextHandle_t handle, const GEOSGeometry* g, double width, int quadsegs, int joinStyle, double mitreLimit);
functions.description: Generates offset curve(s) for the input geometry at the specified distance, returning linework representation.
requirements: handle must be valid
g must be a valid geometry; for LineString input result is a LineString; for Polygon result is boundary offset etc.
width is the offset distance; positive/negative define side
quadsegs positive integer
joinStyle in GEOSBufJoinStyles; mitreLimit positive
Returns new geometry or NULL on exception; free with GEOSGeom_destroy_r

functions.name: GEOSGeom_createPoint_r
functions.signature: extern GEOSGeometry GEOS_DLL *GEOSGeom_createPoint_r(GEOSContextHandle_t handle, GEOSCoordSequence* s);
functions.description: Creates a Point geometry from a coordinate sequence. Ownership of the sequence is transferred to the geometry.
requirements: handle must be valid
s must be a valid GEOSCoordSequence* with size >= 1 and appropriate dimensions (2–4)
On success, caller must free result with GEOSGeom_destroy_r
On error, NULL is returned; do not reuse the sequence after transfer

functions.name: GEOSGeom_createPointFromXY_r
functions.signature: extern GEOSGeometry GEOS_DLL *GEOSGeom_createPointFromXY_r(GEOSContextHandle_t handle, double x, double y);
functions.description: Creates a Point geometry from X and Y coordinates.
requirements: handle must be valid
x and y are finite doubles
Caller must free returned geometry with GEOSGeom_destroy_r

functions.name: GEOSGeom_createEmptyPoint_r
functions.signature: extern GEOSGeometry GEOS_DLL *GEOSGeom_createEmptyPoint_r(GEOSContextHandle_t handle);
functions.description: Creates an empty Point geometry.
requirements: handle must be valid
Caller must free returned geometry with GEOSGeom_destroy_r

functions.name: GEOSGeom_createLinearRing_r
functions.signature: extern GEOSGeometry GEOS_DLL *GEOSGeom_createLinearRing_r(GEOSContextHandle_t handle, GEOSCoordSequence* s);
functions.description: Creates a LinearRing geometry from the given coordinate sequence; ownership of the sequence is transferred.
requirements: handle must be valid
s must describe a closed ring (first==last) with at least 4 points; GEOS may not enforce here but invalid input yields invalid ring
Ownership of s transfers; do not reuse
Caller frees result with GEOSGeom_destroy_r

functions.name: GEOSGeom_createLineString_r
functions.signature: extern GEOSGeometry GEOS_DLL *GEOSGeom_createLineString_r(GEOSContextHandle_t handle, GEOSCoordSequence* s);
functions.description: Creates a LineString geometry from a coordinate sequence (ownership transferred).
requirements: handle must be valid
s must have size >= 0 (empty allowed via empty variant); typical valid non-empty linestring requires size >= 2
Ownership of s transfers
Caller frees result with GEOSGeom_destroy_r

requirements: handle must be valid

requirements: handle must be valid

functions.name: GEOSGeom_createPolygon_r
functions.signature: extern GEOSGeometry GEOS_DLL *GEOSGeom_createPolygon_r(GEOSContextHandle_t handle, GEOSGeometry* shell, GEOSGeometry** holes, unsigned int nholes);
functions.description: Creates a Polygon from a shell LinearRing and optional hole LinearRings. Ownership of ring geometries is transferred to the polygon; the holes array container remains owned by caller.
requirements: handle must be valid
shell must be a LinearRing geometry (non-NULL) or may be empty for empty polygon semantics
holes must point to an array of LinearRing geometries of length nholes (or NULL if nholes==0)
Ownership of shell and each holes[i] transfers to result; the holes array container remains caller-owned
Returns NULL on exception; free result with GEOSGeom_destroy_r

functions.name: GEOSGeom_createCollection_r
functions.signature: extern GEOSGeometry GEOS_DLL *GEOSGeom_createCollection_r(GEOSContextHandle_t handle, int type, GEOSGeometry* *geoms, unsigned int ngeoms);
functions.description: Creates a geometry collection (including Multi* types) of the specified type from an array of geometries. Ownership of elements transfers to the result; the array container remains with caller.
requirements: handle must be valid
type must be one of GEOSGeomTypes (e.g., GEOS_MULTIPOLYGON, GEOS_GEOMETRYCOLLECTION, etc.) compatible with provided elements
geoms points to an array of ngeoms geometry pointers (or NULL with ngeoms==0)
Ownership of geoms[i] transfers; the geoms array container remains caller-owned
Returns NULL on exception; free result with GEOSGeom_destroy_r

functions.name: GEOSGeom_releaseCollection_r
functions.signature: extern GEOSGeometry GEOS_DLL ** GEOSGeom_releaseCollection_r(GEOSContextHandle_t handle, GEOSGeometry * collection, unsigned int * ngeoms);
functions.description: Releases sub-geometries from a collection for caller management. Returns a newly allocated array of GEOSGeometry* and leaves the original collection as an empty collection.
requirements: handle must be valid
collection must be a valid collection geometry
ngeoms must be a non-NULL pointer to receive count
Returned array must be freed with GEOSFree_r(handle, ...) and each element freed with GEOSGeom_destroy_r
On empty collection, may return NULL and set *ngeoms=0; caller must check

functions.name: GEOSGeom_createEmptyCollection_r
functions.signature: extern GEOSGeometry GEOS_DLL *GEOSGeom_createEmptyCollection_r(GEOSContextHandle_t handle, int type);
functions.description: Creates an empty collection (or Multi* geometry) of the specified type.
requirements: handle must be valid
type must be a value from GEOSGeomTypes
Returned geometry must be freed with GEOSGeom_destroy_r

functions.name: GEOSGeom_createRectangle_r
functions.signature: extern GEOSGeometry GEOS_DLL *GEOSGeom_createRectangle_r(GEOSContextHandle_t handle, double xmin, double ymin, double xmax, double ymax);
functions.description: Creates a rectangular polygon from bounds; returns a point if width and height are zero.
requirements: handle must be valid
xmin <= xmax and ymin <= ymax are implied constraints for meaningful rectangle; degenerate to point when both ranges are zero
Returns NULL on exception; free with GEOSGeom_destroy_r

functions.name: GEOSCoverageUnion_r
functions.signature:
extern GEOSGeometry GEOS_DLL *
GEOSCoverageUnion_r(
    GEOSContextHandle_t handle,
    const GEOSGeometry* g);
functions.description: Computes an optimized union for polygonal coverage inputs (polygons that share edges exactly).
requirements: handle must be valid
g must be a collection of polygonal geometries forming a coverage; non-compliant inputs may cause failure (NULL)
Returns new geometry or NULL on exception; free with GEOSGeom_destroy_r

functions.name: GEOSCoverageIsValid_r
functions.description: Analyzes a polygonal coverage to detect overlaps, small gaps (<= gapWidth), and invalid members. Optionally returns a collection of per-input error edges.
requirements: extHandle must be valid
input must be a collection of POLYGON or MULTIPOLYGON members
gapWidth should be >= 0 to detect gaps up to that width
If output is non-NULL, on invalidity it will be set to a geometry; caller must free with GEOSGeom_destroy_r
Returns 1 (valid), 0 (invalid), or 2 (exception). Caller must check return code

functions.name: GEOSCoverageSimplifyVW_r
functions.description: Simplifies a polygonal coverage using Visvalingam–Whyatt while retaining valid coverage topology. Optionally preserves outer boundary.
requirements: extHandle must be valid
input must be a collection of POLYGON/MULTIPOLYGON geometries (a coverage)
tolerance must be >= 0
preserveBoundary is 0/1
Returns a new geometry or NULL on error; free with GEOSGeom_destroy_r
